title: "Why two times?"
description: "Because out of equilibrium the propagator depends on when the perturbation happened, not only on the elapsed time."
categories: [green-functions]

::: {.oneline}
In equilibrium, time-translation invariance collapses two time arguments into one difference. Out of equilibrium that symmetry is gone, and both times carry physical information.
:::

## Short answer
